relationship_to_delivered_experiment: New user-authorized exploratory follow-up after primary and fixed-recovery benchmark outcomes were viewed. All delivered plans, models, outputs and public artifacts remain immutable. This is not a confirmatory benchmark study or a novelty/SOTA claim.
method: Validation-selected global base anchoring; no new training, layerwise search, decoding changes or benchmark-based candidate selection.
formula: theta(alpha) = (1-alpha)*theta_original + alpha*theta_advanced, serialized and checked in FP32.

source_selection.eligible: unchanged source teacher with boxed final answer and native prompt <=2048 tokens

source_protocol.metric: source teacher-answer agreement, not verified truth; pass@1 = fraction of eight agreeing responses and pass@8 = fraction of questions with any agreement

selection_rule.score: harmonic mean of source pass@1 and pass@8; zero if both zero
selection_rule.promotion: strictly greater harmonic score than incumbent with all floors/ceilings met
selection_rule.ranking: highest harmonic score, then highest pass@1, then smaller alpha; exact tie with incumbent retains incumbent

confirmation.gate: the identical fixed floors/ceilings and strict harmonic improvement over incumbent on the disjoint confirmation split
confirmation.limited_power: Operational development gate only; 192 teacher-labeled clusters cannot establish sub-percentage-point superiority or general truth.

benchmark.admission: only one candidate with accepted sealed source confirmation
benchmark.protocol: unchanged primary eight-sample 32K protocol, seed0, batch1024, TP1, BF16, maxseq128, gpuutil0.85, same B200/data/grader/runtime
benchmark.reuse: retain matched original/random/advanced/incumbent benchmark controls; every genuinely new weight candidate requires all nine fresh outputs
benchmark.success_definition: The candidate exceeds original in BOTH pass@1 and pass@8 on the equal-benchmark macro over the eight supplied tasks. Every individual task and supplementary AIME25 is still reported, including regressions. Point-estimate success is distinct from conditional uncertainty or general superiority.

stopping: If no search candidate passes, or the single candidate fails confirmation, preserve the delivered incumbent and report no demonstrated further improvement. Incomplete/failed experiments remain labeled. No benchmark score may change this plan or trigger another candidate.
